signals.title: Diamond share up +0.9pp → 60.9%
signals.detail: 572,317,935 SPX now in the longest-held tier.
signals.framing: Post it — ~8,033,818 SPX just aged into DIAMOND hands (the longest-held, rarely-sold tier). Coins reach it only by being HELD through everything, not by trading — supply maturing into strong hands, conviction deepening. Diamond hands earning the name.
signals.note: Word it as HELD, not BOUGHT: the +8,033,818 came from a cohort aging in from gold (≈ gold -8,859,966), not fresh demand. "Held into diamond" ✓ · "diamonds bought 8,033,818" ✗.
